battle.name: 利比亞內戰
battle.brief: 利比亞內戰於2011年2月爆發，反政府武裝推翻蓋達夫政權後，內部派系爭奪與跨國軍事介入交織。北約空中行動展開之際，英國向利比亞部署「挑戰者2」主戰坦克，用於護送撤運、占領重要設施及支援地面部隊，成為這場衝突中英軍裝甲力量的代表。

kit.name: 挑戰者2主戰坦克
kit.history: 「挑戰者2」是英國陸軍的主戰坦克，隸屬裝甲部隊，負責正面突破、對抗敵方裝甲並占領要害地區，與步兵、工程車及後勤支援車輛協同作戰。

countries: 2011年利比亞內戰的戰場從東部地中海沿岸的班加西、貝達、達爾納與阿季達里亞，沿海岸公路、內陸沙漠道路及奈富薩山口一路延伸到扎維耶、的黎波里、米蘇拉塔、辛坦、昔蘭與班尼瓦利德。東部先形成主要起義，西部則在二月下旬由米蘇拉塔、扎維耶和奈富薩方向相繼出現武裝控制，因此戰線並非由單一首都向全國均勻擴散。交戰方先是穆阿邁爾·蓋達菲領導的利比亞政府軍、空軍與安全部隊，對上由東部起義軍、西部武裝、地方民兵及後來被全國過渡委員會納入或承認的部隊所組成的鬆散聯盟；軍區與部隊倒戈使固定戰序經常改變。美國、英國與法國於3月19日先行執行奧德賽黎明行動，北約盟國其後在3月27日接手統一保護行動。埃及與突尼斯方向的邊境主要是補給和交通通道，北約沒有部署地面進攻部隊，地面控制權仍由利比亞各方爭奪。
countriesEn: The geographic theater of the 2011 Libyan Civil War ran from Benghazi, Bayda, Derna, and Ajdiria on the eastern Mediterranean coast, along coastal roads, inland desert tracks, and the Nafusa mountain passes, to Zawiya, Tripoli, Misrata, Zintan, Sirte, and Bani Walid. The main uprising arose first in the east, while in late February armed control appeared around Misrata, Zawiya, and the Nafusa at the same time, so the front did not spread evenly outward from a single capital. The belligerents were the Libyan government forces, air force, and security units under Muammar Gaddafi, opposed by a loose coalition of eastern insurgents, western armed groups, local militias, and units later incorporated or recognized by the National Transitional Council; defections by military districts and units continually changed the order of battle. The United States, United Kingdom, and France began Operation Odyssey Dawn on 19 March, and NATO members took over Operation Unified Protector on 27 March. The borders with Egypt and Tunisia mainly served as supply and transit routes, NATO deployed no ground assault force, and ground control remained contested among Libyan factions.
people: 蓋達菲以利比亞最高政治與軍事領導人的身分，直接掌握軍隊忠誠、軍區命令與空軍運用；制空權一旦下降，遠程打擊就難以掩護地面部隊，政府軍的指揮鏈也會因倒戈而分段。反對陣營沒有由一開始就存在的單一總部。穆斯塔法·阿卜杜勒·賈利勒以全國過渡委員會主席身分負責政治協調；阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·尤尼斯在阿季達里亞率領早期武裝，歐邁爾·哈里里是西部戰線的主要指揮者，哈利法·哈夫塔爾則在東部起義中成為主要軍事將領之一，後來又與全國過渡委員會的指揮安排發生衝突。馬哈茂德·吉布里勒參與過渡委員會的行政與軍事協調。美國參聯會主席邁克·穆倫在總統授權後下令美軍開始打擊，北約則由那不勒斯聯合部隊司令部協調各國空中與海上力量，但各國仍保有本國部隊的指揮權。
peopleEn: Gaddafi was Libya’s central political and military authority, directly controlling military loyalty, district orders, and the use of the air force; once air superiority declined, long-range strikes could no longer readily protect ground forces, and the government’s command structure fragmented as units defected. The opposition did not possess a single headquarters from the beginning. Mustafa Abdul Jalil handled political coordination as chairman of the National Transitional Council; Abdel Fattah Younis led early armed forces in Ajdiria, Omar Hariri was a principal commander on the western front, and Khalifa Haftar became one of the major military figures in the eastern uprising before later clashing with the council’s command arrangements. Mahmoud Jibril participated in the council’s administrative and military coordination. After presidential authorization, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff Mike Mullen ordered the United States military to begin strikes. NATO coordinated national air and maritime forces through Joint Force Command Naples, although each country retained command over its own units.
kits: 可由2011年公開影像、裝甲辨識及戰後公開清單交叉確認的核心型號，構成這場戰爭的主要裝備面。政府軍裝甲包括T-54/T-55與T-72，步兵戰車包括BMP-1和BMP-2，裝甲運兵車包括BTR-50與BTR-60；前線火力可辨識到2S1 Gvozdika自走榴彈砲、BM-21 Grad多管火箭砲及122毫米火砲。防空單位配備S-75 Dvina與S-125 Pechora系統，空軍保有MiG-21、MiG-23、MiG-25、Su-22、Su-24和L-39，直升機包括Mi-8與Mi-24，但不少飛機因零件、燃料和維修不足而不能持續升空。反軍武裝大量使用AK-47、AKM、PKM、DShK、RPG-7與RPG-29，並把這些武器裝載於皮卡車；後來也繳獲並修復政府軍的坦克、步兵戰車與火砲。公開任務記錄可辨識的北約及聯盟空中單元包括F-15E、F-16、F/A-18、A-10、B-1B、AH-64、Tornado GR4、Lynx GR4、Rafale和Super Étendard，使用精確制導炸彈、戰斧巡航飛彈、SCALP與Storm Shadow。彈藥規格也影響戰術：T-54/T-55使用100毫米砲彈，T-72使用125毫米砲彈，BMP-1配73毫米砲，BMP-2配30毫米砲；反軍常見7.62毫米與12.7毫米機槍彈，北約則以精確炸彈和巡航飛彈攻擊雷達、防空系統、彈藥庫、指揮所與裝甲目標。上述型號均在2011年以前已進入各國或利比亞軍隊的編制。
kitsEn: The core equipment profile of the war can be cross-checked against public imagery, armored-vehicle identification, and postwar inventories. Government armor included T-54/T-55 and T-72 tanks, BMP-1 and BMP-2 infantry fighting vehicles, and BTR-50 and BTR-60 armored personnel carriers. Identifiable front-line firepower included 2S1 Gvozdika self-propelled howitzers, BM-21 Grad multiple rocket launchers, and 122-millimeter artillery. Air-defense units fielded S-75 Dvina and S-125 Pechora systems, while the air force retained MiG-21, MiG-23, MiG-25, Su-22, Su-24, and L-39 aircraft, together with Mi-8 and Mi-24 helicopters, although many aircraft could not remain airborne because of shortages of parts, fuel, and maintenance. Rebel forces used large quantities of AK-47, AKM, PKM, DShK, RPG-7, and RPG-29 weapons, often mounted on pickup trucks; they later captured and repaired government tanks, infantry fighting vehicles, and artillery. Public mission records identify NATO and coalition air units including F-15E, F-16, F/A-18, A-10, B-1B, AH-64, Tornado GR4, Lynx GR4, Rafale, and Super Étendard aircraft, employing precision-guided bombs, Tomahawk cruise missiles, SCALP, and Storm Shadow. Ammunition specifications also shaped tactics: T-54/T-55 tanks used 100-millimeter rounds, T-72 tanks used 125-millimeter rounds, BMP-1 carried a 73-millimeter gun, and BMP-2 carried a 30-millimeter gun; rebel forces commonly used 7.62-millimeter and 12.7-millimeter machine-gun ammunition, while NATO relied on precision bombs and cruise missiles against radars, air-defense systems, ammunition depots, command posts, and armored targets. All these types had entered service before 2011.
tactics: 戰術演變可以分成相互重疊的幾個階段。2月16日班加西出現政治抗議，17日部分軍警倒戈，武裝起義者奪取軍政節點；到19日前後，班加西、貝達、達爾納與阿季達里亞的主要道路先後換手。這些部隊沒有立即組成單一軍隊，而是以地方支部、臨時營和皮卡車快速隊行動，沿海岸公路切斷政府軍的補給線，並在裝甲縱隊通過狹窄路段時以RPG-7、RPG-29和其他反裝甲武器伏擊。政府軍依靠坦克、火砲、飛機與直昇機反擊，試圖守住機場、城市入口和主要公路，但每次集中調動都會暴露位置。2月下旬，西部隊伍從奈富薩山路、沿海公路和的黎波里外圍向首都施壓；政府軍則以裝甲車和火砲在米蘇拉塔、扎維耶及奈富薩各據點之間進行反擊，試圖把起義分割成幾個孤立戰區。3月19日，美英法第一波打擊集中於利比亞防空雷達、發射車、指揮設施、彈藥庫及空軍基地；3月27日北約接手後，把禁飛區、海上武器禁運、情報監視與近距空援連接起來。4月至6月，米蘇拉塔仍由起義軍守住，政府軍不斷從周邊據點進行炮擊和裝甲反突，北約則打擊包圍圈附近的火砲、裝甲車與指揮節點。7月至8月，多支起義部隊由西部和南部向的黎波里集結，政府軍試圖以裝甲預備隊打通 Bab al-Ghazala 與 Green Mile 等通道，北約空襲削弱其防空和火砲支援，8月21日的黎波里控制權轉移。9月至10月，起義軍以海岸線和沙漠道路逼近昔蘭，利用繳獲的火砲與反裝甲武器對付政府軍殘部，北約持續提供空中掩護直到10月15日；昔蘭在密集地面戰中於10月20日陷落，而班尼瓦利德仍由忠軍控制。
tacticsEn: The tactical course can be divided into several overlapping phases. Political protests appeared in Benghazi on 16 February, and on 17 February some military and police units defected as armed insurgents seized military and administrative positions; by around 19 February, the main roads in Benghazi, Bayda, Derna, and Ajdiria had changed hands. These forces did not immediately form a single army. They operated through local detachments, temporary battalions, and pickup-based mobile units, cutting government supply lines along the coastal road and ambushing armored columns with RPG-7, RPG-29, and other anti-armor weapons as they passed through confined stretches. Government forces counterattacked with tanks, artillery, aircraft, and helicopters, trying to hold airports, city entrances, and major roads, but every concentrated movement exposed its position. In late February, western forces pressed toward Tripoli from the Nafusa routes, the coastal corridor, and the outskirts of the capital. Government units used armored vehicles and artillery to counterattack between positions in Misrata, Zawiya, and the Nafusa, attempting to divide the uprising into isolated theaters. On 19 March, the first American, British, and French strikes concentrated on Libyan air-defense radars, launchers, command facilities, ammunition depots, and air bases. After NATO assumed command on 27 March, it connected the no-fly zone, maritime arms enforcement, intelligence surveillance, and close air support. From April through June, the insurgents continued to hold Misrata while government forces staged artillery bombardments and armored counterattacks from surrounding positions, and NATO struck artillery, armored vehicles, and command nodes around the siege. From July through August, several rebel formations converged on Tripoli from the west and south. Government forces attempted to open corridors through Bab al-Ghazala and the Green Mile with armored reserves, while NATO air attacks weakened their air defense and artillery support; Tripoli changed hands on 21 August. From September through October, rebel forces approached Sirte along the coast and desert roads, using captured artillery and anti-armor weapons against government remnants. NATO maintained air cover until 15 October, Sirte fell in close ground fighting on 20 October, and Bani Walid remained under loyalist control.
data: 可核對的硬日期、路線與後勤資料構成這場戰爭的時間骨架。2月16日班加西的政治危機成為全面起義的公開起點，2月17日至19日班加西及東部數個城市的控制權相繼轉移；2月下旬，米蘇拉塔、扎維耶、奈富薩與辛坦方向的武裝控制逐步成形。3月17日聯合國安全理事會通過第1973號決議，3月19日美英法開始空襲，3月27日北約正式接手統一保護行動，8月21日的黎波里陷落，10月15日北約宣布統一保護行動結束，10月20日昔蘭陷落且蓋達菲被捕身亡。空間上，海岸公路構成東西向主要走廊，奈富薩山路連接辛坦、扎維耶和的黎波里，昔蘭是東線與西線的交通瓶頸，班尼瓦利德則控制通往內陸的公路和沙漠側翼。外部補給主要經埃及邊境與突尼斯方向進入，北約則以空中加油、衛星情報、指揮機和地中海艦艇維持長距離作戰。政府軍依賴儲存於空軍基地與大型彈藥庫的100毫米、125毫米、122毫米、73毫米和30毫米彈藥，反軍的7.62毫米與12.7毫米彈藥較易攜帶，但重型火砲、反裝甲武器、備件、燃料和輪胎較為不足。政府軍仍以軍區和正式營旅作戰，反軍則以臨時營、地方武裝和後來編成的旅為主，整個過程沒有一份固定戰序涵蓋全部部隊。各方發布的人員損失總數因統計時間、定義與來源不同而互相矛盾，因此本篇不列出未經核實的精確傷亡數字。
dataEn: The verifiable dates, routes, and logistics form the backbone of the chronology. The political crisis in Benghazi on 16 February became the public starting point for the full uprising, and control of Benghazi and several eastern cities changed between 17 and 19 February; in late February, armed control gradually took shape around Misrata, Zawiya, the Nafusa, and Zintan. On 17 March the United Nations Security Council adopted Resolution 1973, the United States, United Kingdom, and France began airstrikes on 19 March, and NATO formally assumed command of Operation Unified Protector on 27 March. Tripoli fell on 21 August, NATO announced the end of Unified Protector on 15 October, and Sirte fell on 20 October, when Gaddafi was captured and killed. Geographically, the coastal highway formed the main east-west corridor, the Nafusa routes connected Zintan, Zawiya, and Tripoli, Sirte was a transport bottleneck between the eastern and western fronts, and Bani Walid controlled roads and desert approaches into the interior. External supplies entered mainly through the Egyptian border and the direction of Tunisia, while NATO sustained long-range operations through aerial refueling, satellite intelligence, command aircraft, and Mediterranean naval forces. Government forces depended on 100-millimeter, 125-millimeter, 122-millimeter, 73-millimeter, and 30-millimeter ammunition stored at air bases and large depots. Rebel 7.62-millimeter and 12.7-millimeter ammunition was easier to transport, but heavy artillery, anti-armor weapons, spare parts, fuel, and tires were scarcer. Government units continued to operate through military districts and formal battalions and regiments, while rebel forces were organized around temporary battalions, local armed groups, and later brigades; no single order of battle covered every force throughout the conflict. Published personnel-loss totals varied because of different dates, definitions, and sources, so this account does not state an unverified precise casualty figure.
cause: 這場戰爭的根源是蓋達菲 Jamahiriya 體制下政治、軍隊、安全機構與資源分配的高度集中。長期以來，昔蘭尼卡地區在行政權力、軍事晉升和國家資源分配上感受到被邊緣化，西部地區則存在部落與地區認同、徵兵待遇和地方自治方面的衝突；石油收入與軍政 patronage 又使政治忠誠成為資源分配的關鍵。2010年突尼亞與埃及的革命形成區域性震盪，2011年2月16日班加西的政治抗議和2月17日開始的軍警倒戈，則把不滿轉化為武裝衝突。起義初期，地方單位各自奪取道路、營區與政府設施，政府軍企圖用重裝備、火砲和航空力量保住中央控制，卻因部隊倒戈而逐步失去縱深。3月的聯合國授權與北約空中介入不是戰爭最初的起因，卻使政府更難以重新奪回已失去的城市，也把原本由利比亞內部部隊主導的衝突轉化為有外國空軍與艦隊介入的國際化戰爭。
causeEn: The roots of the war lay in the highly centralized Jamahiriya system, where political power, the armed forces, security institutions, and resource distribution were concentrated in a narrow structure. The Cyrenaica region had long felt excluded from administrative authority, military promotion, and national resources, while western areas experienced conflicts involving tribal and regional identities, conscription treatment, and local autonomy. Oil revenues and military-political patronage made political loyalty a key to access and command. The revolutions in Tunisia and Egypt in 2010 created a regional shock, while the political protests in Benghazi on 16 February 2011 and the military and police defections that began on 17 February converted discontent into armed conflict. At first, local units seized roads, barracks, and government facilities on their own, while the government tried to preserve central control with heavy weapons, artillery, and aviation but lost depth as more units defected. The United Nations authorization and NATO air intervention in March were not the original causes of the conflict, yet they made it much harder for the government to retake cities that had already been lost and turned a conflict led by Libyan internal units into an internationalized war involving foreign aircraft and naval forces.
impact: 最直接的軍事影響，是蓋達菲政府的中央指揮體系在戰役後期失去連續性，空軍無法有效爭奪制空權，防空系統、火砲陣地和彈藥庫在反軍逼近時相繼失能或被摧毀。大批政府軍坦克、步兵戰車、火砲、防空設備和小型武器落入起義軍手中，使原本缺乏重裝備的地方武裝迅速獲得機動作戰能力，也讓不同反軍派系在短期內擁有各自的裝甲與防空火力。北約則以空中優勢、禁飛區、海上武器禁運和精確打擊展示了沒有地面進攻部隊的遠程干預模式，同時保留了由利比亞地面部隊決定城市控制權的格局。政治上，蓋達菲政權失去國家權力，全國過渡委員會成為大部分城市和行政資源的事實上的中央權力核心，但軍隊並未整合成單一國家軍隊，東部、西部和不同武裝派系反而形成新的競爭力量。國際上，第1973號決議、北約統一保護行動與區域國家的補給和安全安排，改變了阿拉伯之春期間外部介入的邊界；利比亞軍庫與武裝化力量流向不同政治派系，也成為2011年之後安全與政治危機的軍事基礎。
impactEn: The most direct military effect was the loss of continuity in the central command system of the Gaddafi government during the later stages of the war. The air force could no longer contest air superiority effectively, and air-defense systems, artillery positions, and ammunition depots were disabled or destroyed as rebel forces approached. Large quantities of government tanks, infantry fighting vehicles, artillery, air-defense equipment, and small arms fell into rebel hands, allowing poorly equipped local forces to acquire mobile combat capability quickly and giving different rebel factions their own armor and air defenses. NATO demonstrated a form of long-range intervention based on air superiority, a no-fly zone, maritime arms enforcement, and precision strikes without a ground assault force, while leaving control of cities to Libyan ground forces. Politically, the Gaddafi regime lost state power and the National Transitional Council became the de facto central authority over most cities and administrative resources, but the military was not consolidated into a single national army; eastern, western, and factional forces instead became competing armed actors. Internationally, Resolution 1973, Operation Unified Protector, and regional supply and security arrangements changed the boundaries of external involvement during the Arab uprisings. The dispersal of Libyan weapons and armed forces among rival political groups also supplied the military foundation for the security and political crises that followed 2011.
result: 結局可以分成戰役層次與國家層次。戰役層次上，反軍由東部起義開始，經米蘇拉塔、扎維耶、奈富薩與昔蘭等戰線推進，最終迫使政府軍放棄主要城市；的黎波里在8月21日失守，昔蘭在10月20日失守，蓋達菲當日被捕身亡。北約在10月15日結束統一保護行動，而地面攻勢仍延續到10月20日，這說明空戰任務的結束時間與地面政治決定的時間並不相同。國家層次上，蓋達菲政府及其中央軍事指揮系統實際上瓦解，全國過渡委員會接管首都和大部分行政資源，成為新的過渡權力核心；但這不是所有忠軍立即投降或全國完成解除武裝。班尼瓦利德到2011年底仍由忠軍控制，部分部隊和大量裝備則分散到不同武裝派系手中。因此，2011年的結果是政府軍在主要戰線上的戰略失敗與蓋達菲政權垮台，而不是全國各地同時建立穩定、統一且完成解除武裝的秩序；後續的政治分裂和軍事競爭，正是從這個未完全平復的結果延伸而來。本篇不提供各方互相矛盾的精確傷亡總數。
resultEn: The outcome can be divided into a campaign level and a state level. At the campaign level, the rebellion began in the east, advanced through fronts including Misrata, Zawiya, the Nafusa, and Sirte, and eventually forced government forces to abandon the major cities. Tripoli fell on 21 August, Sirte fell on 20 October, and Gaddafi was captured and killed that day. NATO ended Operation Unified Protector on 15 October, while the ground offensive continued until 20 October, showing that the end of the air mission and the decisive ground political outcome did not occur on the same day. At the state level, the Gaddafi government and its central military command structure effectively collapsed. The National Transitional Council took control of the capital and most administrative resources and became the new transitional authority, but this did not mean that every loyalist force immediately surrendered or that the country was fully disarmed. Bani Walid remained under loyalist control at the end of 2011, while scattered units and large quantities of equipment passed into the hands of different armed factions. The result was therefore the strategic defeat of government forces on the principal fronts and the fall of the Gaddafi regime, not the simultaneous establishment of a stable, unified, fully disarmed order across the country; later political fragmentation and military competition developed directly from this incompletely settled outcome. This account does not provide the conflicting precise casualty totals issued by the different sides.
